[!symlink] skip 'fake GOROOT needs symlinks'
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOWORK=off
env CGO_ENABLED=0

# A residual that names a Go release tag must not pin the emitted file
# to that version's semantics: the export keeps the original structure
# with version-neutral mode tags, so plain-Go builds select the file
# under the package language version. The fixture closes over its loop
# variable, which older per-file versions share across iterations while
# the package version keeps distinct. A legacy-only guard never set a
# per-file version at all, so its residual must stay versionless too:
# the second fixture carries only a // +build line and asserts the same
# behavior from the exported build. The test installs fixture packages
# in a private toolchain root inside $WORK and selects it with GOROOT.
# Nothing is written into the real GOROOT.
go run mkgoroot.go $TESTGO_GOROOT $WORK/fakegoroot dep
env GOROOT=$WORK/fakegoroot
cd m

# Native semantics: logosejected is unset, so each file is selected with
# no implied file version and each closure keeps its iteration's value.
logos run .
stdout -count=2 '^1$'
stdout -count=2 '^2$'

logos eject -o out
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestrel/item.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestlegacy/item.go
grep -count=1 '^//go:build go1.21 [|][|] [(]ignore && !ignore[)]' out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestrel/item.go
grep -count=1 '^//go:build go1.27 [|][|] [(]ignore && !ignore[)]' out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestlegacy/item.go
! grep 'logosejected' out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestrel/item.go
! grep 'logosejected' out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestlegacy/item.go

env GOROOT=$TESTGO_GOROOT
cd out
go build -mod=readonly ./...
go run .
stdout -count=2 '^1$'
stdout -count=2 '^2$'
# Each residual selects like its source guard: the default list keeps
# both files.
go list -f '{{.GoFiles}}' github.com/gosuda/loGos/rt/logos/ejecttestrel
stdout 'item.go'
go list -f '{{.GoFiles}}' github.com/gosuda/loGos/rt/logos/ejecttestlegacy
stdout 'item.go'

-- mkgoroot.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"
)

func must(err error, what string) {
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "mkgoroot: %s: %v\n", what, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func link(oldname, newname string) {
	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(newname), 0777), "mkdir "+filepath.Dir(newname))
	must(os.Symlink(oldname, newname), "symlink "+newname)
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 4 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: mkgoroot <realGOROOT> <fakeRoot> <fixtures>")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	real, fake, fixtures := os.Args[1], os.Args[2], os.Args[3]

	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), 0777), "mkdir fake src/logos")

	ents, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(real, "src"))
	must(err, "read real src")
	for _, e := range ents {
		if e.Name() == "logos" {
			continue
		}
		link(filepath.Join(real, "src", e.Name()), filepath.Join(fake, "src", e.Name()))
	}

	must(os.CopyFS(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), os.DirFS(filepath.Join(real, "src", "logos"))), "copy support sources")
	must(os.CopyFS(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), os.DirFS(fixtures)), "install fixture packages")

	// The package index distinguishes .lgo-only standard packages, but
	// bypasses files with recent mtimes. Age only the private copies.
	old := time.Now().Add(-time.Hour)
	must(filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), func(name string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil || !d.Type().IsRegular() {
			return err
		}
		return os.Chtimes(name, old, old)
	}), "age copied support and fixture files")

	link(filepath.Join(real, "pkg"), filepath.Join(fake, "pkg"))
	link(filepath.Join(real, "VERSION"), filepath.Join(fake, "VERSION"))
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(real, "go.env")); err == nil {
		link(filepath.Join(real, "go.env"), filepath.Join(fake, "go.env"))
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(real, "lib")); err == nil {
		link(filepath.Join(real, "lib"), filepath.Join(fake, "lib"))
	}
}

-- dep/ejecttestrel/item.lgo --
//go:build !logosejected || go1.21

package ejecttestrel

func Vals() []int {
	var fns []func() int
	for _, v := range []int{1, 2} {
		fns = append(fns, func() int { return v })
	}
	out := make([]int, 0, len(fns))
	for _, fn := range fns {
		out = append(out, fn())
	}
	return out
}

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/reldep

go 1.27


-- dep/ejecttestlegacy/item.lgo --
// +build !logosejected,go1.21 go1.27

package ejecttestlegacy

func Vals() []int {
	var fns []func() int
	for _, v := range []int{1, 2} {
		fns = append(fns, func() int { return v })
	}
	out := make([]int, 0, len(fns))
	for _, fn := range fns {
		out = append(out, fn())
	}
	return out
}
-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/ejecttestlegacy"
	"logos/ejecttestrel"
)

func main() {
	for _, v := range ejecttestrel.Vals() {
		fmt.Println(v)
	}
	for _, v := range ejecttestlegacy.Vals() {
		fmt.Println(v)
	}
}
